entries.summary: Data Foundation shipped: 6 master entities (Supplier/Staff/Dealer/Grade/Design/Design-Grade Map) with CRUD admin + soft-delete + UNIQUE constraints; 40 tasks complete; 46/46 TCs pass; 4/4 IS scenarios; 3/3 STs executed (2 deferred to S3); UAT 19/19 accepted; final audit SHIP.

entries.description: Migration 0002_master_tables.py hand-authored from ORM (no PG available at dev time). DDL exactly mirrors Base.metadata; IS-002 verifies alembic+seed succeed against fresh PG. Final `alembic check` deferred until PO closes W5.

T-025 seed runtime verification (`python -m scripts.seed_master_data` → 33 rows + 0-reinsert idempotency) deferred until W5 closes. Static cross-check against TC expected_output is CLEAN; IS-002 covers ephemerally.

TimestampMixin uses Mapped[datetime] → SQLAlchemy emits plain TIMESTAMP (without timezone). LLD prose mentions TIMESTAMPTZ. Migration mirrors ORM per DS-009. If timezone semantics are needed, edit base.py to `mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), ...)` and ship a follow-up migration.

entries.title: W5 — PO completes long-lived PG bring-up
entries.description: Required steps (sequential): (1) write backend/.env with DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://trading_app:<pwd>@localhost:5432/jayanth_trading; (2) docker-compose up -d db; (3) cd backend && alembic upgrade head; (4) python -m scripts.seed_master_data; (5) re-run step 4 to confirm 0-insert idempotency. Closes TD-005 + TD-006.

entries.title: TIMESTAMP vs TIMESTAMPTZ drift between ORM and LLD prose
entries.description: ORM TimestampMixin emits plain TIMESTAMP; LLD prose mentions TIMESTAMPTZ. Materializes only if deployment timezone differs from PG container's timezone. Mitigation plan: TIMESTAMPTZ migration in S2 (TD-007).

entries.title: Long-lived PG dev environment not yet bootstrapped
